question: At what location and in what manner is one prescribed to place and drink the air?
premises: The location prescribed is the root of the tongue and palate.
Having placed the air there, an action is prescribed.
That action is to drink the air slowly.
inference: Having placed the air at the root of the tongue and palate, one should drink it slowly.
uncertainties: The purpose of this practice is not stated here.
plain_english: Having placed the air at the root of the tongue and palate, one should drink it slowly.
